title: Formalize repository-owner acceptance of ADR-0016 (Architecture Studio scope expansion): set Status to Accepted, assign DEC-054, update the ADR index and master decision log
objective: Owner-directed, explicit approval given: the repository owner was asked directly whether to formally accept ADR-0016 (docs/adr/ADR-0016-architecture-studio-scope-expansion.md, previously Status: Proposed) now that they are directing implementation to begin ('Vamos refatorar o architecture studio para usar next e colocar os elementos para testar tudo + ia + o que esta planejado'), and chose 'Sim, aceitar agora'. Per docs/adr/TEMPLATE.md and docs/adr/README.md's own authoring workflow, only the repository owner may set an ADR's Status past Proposed, assign the decision date, or fill the Decision section -- this task performs that mechanical recording of the owner's own explicit decision (not an agent-originated judgment call), following the exact same pattern already used for DEC-050 through DEC-053. The next available decision number is DEC-054 (DEC-053 is the highest existing entry in GRAFTING_MASTER_SOURCE.md section 3.1's decision log).
validations: docs/adr/ADR-0016-architecture-studio-scope-expansion.md: Status changed from Proposed to Accepted, Decision date set to 2026-08-01, Record set to DEC-054, and the 'Decision' section's 'Pending repository-owner decision' framing replaced with settled text (the three-surface scope, superseding ADR-0012's exclusion sentence for surfaces 2 and 3 only, is now in effect).
docs/adr/README.md's Index table gains an ADR-0016 row following the existing table's exact column format and phrasing style used by ADR-0012/ADR-0014/ADR-0015.

GRAFTING_MASTER_SOURCE.md section 3.1's decision log gains a DEC-054 row (same one-paragraph style as DEC-050 through DEC-053, citing docs/adr/ADR-0016-architecture-studio-scope-expansion.md) and the file's 'Last updated' banner line is refreshed to name this decision, matching the existing convention set by the DEC-053 banner update.

No other ADR-0016 content is rewritten beyond the Status/Decision-section mechanics -- the Summary, Context, Scope, Options, Consequences, Risks, Rollback, and Follow-up work sections are left exactly as drafted, since the owner accepted the proposal as written.
artifacts: docs/adr/ADR-0016-architecture-studio-scope-expansion.md (Status: Accepted, Decision date 2026-08-01, Record DEC-054, Decision/Risks/Rollback sections settled)
GRAFTING_MASTER_SOURCE.md (DEC-054 row added to the section 3.1 decision log; 'Last updated' banner refreshed)
risks: This records the repository owner's own explicit choice (given via a direct clarifying question in this session) rather than an agent-originated interpretation; the same record could not have been written on an agent's own initiative.

No dependency installed, no application code touched -- documentation/decision-log mechanics only. Actual implementation (Next.js migration, VTT generation-test surface, agent-orchestration backend) is deliberately out of scope for this task and follows as separate, later task(s).
